description: Tattoo product photography visual language — static product images only

product_position.description: How the product is positioned within the frame
terms: floating centered — product isolated against background, no surface contact
floating 45 degree — product angled at 45°, floating in frame
overhead flat lay — directly top-down on flat surface
angled flat lay — top-down at slight angle, perspective visible
upright standing — product standing vertically on base
horizontal layout — product laid horizontally across frame
hero single — single product as main subject, centered
clustered arrangement — multiple products grouped aesthetically
row layout — products arranged in linear row
tilted forward — product tipped forward toward camera
three-quarter view — product shown at 3/4 angle
side profile — product viewed from side, silhouette visible
low angle looking up — camera below product, heroic perspective
mounted on machine — cartridge attached to machine, machine visible
held in gloved hand — product held by gloved hand, human scale
held in bare hand — product held by bare clean hand
finger grip display — product pinched between fingers
palm display — product resting on open palm
next-to-scale — product next to coin, ruler, or hand for scale
disassembled layout — product shown in parts, exploded view

lighting_style.description: Lighting treatment specific to product photography
terms: commercial studio lighting — even, clean, multiple softboxes
clinical clean lighting — bright, shadowless, medical aesthetic
high key studio — bright white background, minimal shadows
low key studio — dark background, product highlighted
dramatic shadow lighting — strong shadows, single light source
rim lighting — light hitting edges only, product outlined
backlight silhouette — product dark against bright background
hard side lighting — single strong light from one side
soft diffused lighting — softbox or diffuser, gentle shadows
black background spotlight — product lit against pure black
white background infinity — seamless white, floating effect
gradient background lighting — background fades dark to light
neon accent lighting — colored neon light on one side
LED cold lighting — cool blue-white LED, industrial feel
warm tungsten lighting — warm incandescent, cozy feel
mixed color temperature — warm + cool lights combined
ring light macro — ring light, even macro illumination
cross lighting — two lights at 45°, minimal shadows
overhead studio lighting — main light from above
natural window light — soft daylight from window
metallic reflection lighting — lights positioned to highlight chrome
transparent backlight — light through translucent product
matte flat lighting — even diffused, no specular highlights
glossy accent lighting — controlled reflections on glossy surfaces

background_style.description: Background treatment and surface context for product
terms: pure black seamless — black background, no texture visible
pure white seamless — white background, infinity effect
dark gradient — black fading to dark gray gradient
studio paper roll — seamless paper curve background
industrial metal surface — brushed metal worktable
black matte acrylic — black gloss/matte acrylic sheet
white marble texture — white marble surface, luxury feel
wooden desk surface — warm wood grain background
leather mat — textured leather work surface
sterile clinical surface — clean white medical surface
paper towel surface — textured paper towel, studio realism
plastic tray surface — translucent medical tray
workstation desk — actual tattoo workstation with tools
tool pegboard — wall pegboard with tools hanging
brick wall texture — rough brick wall, urban feel
concrete texture — raw concrete, industrial aesthetic
neon-lit wall — wall with neon sign lighting
blurred studio background — out-of-focus studio elements
glass shelf — transparent glass shelving
vinyl couch texture — textured vinyl upholstery
convention booth — tattoo convention booth setup
natural room background — real room, depth visible
black acrylic reflection — product reflected on glossy black surface
frosted acrylic — translucent frosted panel background

material_behavior.description: Material-specific visual properties visible on the product
terms: glossy plastic reflection — bright specular highlights on plastic
matte plastic finish — non-reflective, soft plastic texture
transparent plastic clarity — see-through plastic, clarity visible
frosted plastic diffusion — translucent frosted plastic
chrome metallic reflection — mirror-like chrome finish
brushed metal texture — fine parallel scratches on metal
anodized metal finish — colored metal, matte metallic
stainless steel gloss — clean steel, subtle reflection
titanium gradient — color shift surface, rainbow tint
gold plating reflection — warm gold metallic sheen
copper/bronze tone — warm brown metallic surface
rubberized grip texture — soft-touch matte black grip
silicone soft texture — flexible translucent material
carbon fiber pattern — woven dark pattern texture
black nitrile glove grip — textured glove holding product
ink residue stain — ink marks on surface or glove
paper texture — textured cardboard or paper packaging
plastic blister pack — vacuum-formed plastic packaging
foam insert texture — dark foam cutout holding product
velvet/lining texture — soft interior case lining
cable / wire texture — twisted or braided cable surface
O-ring / rubber seal — small rubber ring on cartridge
needle tip reflection — tiny metal needle point glint
cartridge membrane visible — translucent membrane on cartridge base
label / print texture — printed logo, wear on label
barcode / serial mark — product identification marking

camera_style.description: Camera and lens approach for product capture
terms: macro close-up — very tight on product, minimal context
extreme macro — needle tip or cartridge membrane detail
medium close-up — product fills frame, some context
product full frame — entire product visible, tight crop
detail macro — specific feature or texture emphasized
shotgun wide — multiple products visible together
commercial product shot — polished, symmetrical product view
documentary style — raw, unprocessed product view
flat lay overhead — camera directly above, 90°
45 degree angle shot — camera at 45° to product
eye-level shot — camera at product height
low angle product — camera below product line
dutch angle — tilted frame, dynamic feel
selective focus macro — very shallow depth of field
sharp focus full — entire product in focus
focus stack look — front-to-back sharp (simulated or real)
handheld natural — slight camera movement, organic feel
locked down tripod — perfectly still, no movement
rotating turntable — product slowly rotating (video)
pull-back reveal — camera pulling back to show context
push-in detail — camera moving in to highlight detail

composition_style.description: Frame composition and visual arrangement principles
terms: center composition — product dead center, symmetrical
rule of thirds — product on third line, negative space
tight framing — minimal space around product
negative space dominant — large empty area, product small
minimal negative space — product fills most of frame
asymmetrical balance — weighted to one side, visually balanced
symmetrical balance — mirrored left-right balance
diagonal leading line — product placed diagonally
top-down symmetry — perfectly centered from above
layered depth — foreground product, background context
isolated subject — product separated from background
group composition — multiple products arranged intentionally
golden spiral placement — product at spiral focal point
frame within frame — product framed by other elements
reflection composition — product + reflection visible
cinematic aspect ratio — wide crop, letterbox feel
square crop studio — 1:1 social media format
portrait orientation crop — tall vertical frame
landscape orientation crop — wide horizontal frame
minimalist composition — few elements, clean and simple
